snippet.title: Grimroll Trailer
snippet.description: Grimroll is a dice-based roguelike adventure where you wield dice in grid-based combat, chaining powerful combos. Brave a forbidden forest, battling creatures from Slavic myths as you seek the legendary Old Crone, said to grant any wish, if you can survive her trials.
